title: Lisbon's Hills Will Humble You (Bring Better Shoes)
description: Tram 28, a pastel de nata every ninety minutes to stay motivated, and a sunset from Miradouro da Senhora do Monte that made the calf pain worth it. A one-day walking itinerary for Lisbon that leans into the hills instead of fighting them, including which viewpoints justify the climb and which are just stairs with marketing.
